title: RBI Charter of Customer Rights for Banking Consumers
content: The RBI Charter of Customer Rights establishes 5 core rights for financial consumers in India: 1. Right to Fair Treatment. 2. Right to Transparency, Fair and Honest Dealing. 3. Right to Suitability. 4. Right to Privacy. 5. Right to Grievance Redressal and Compensation. Consumers facing unresolved complaints with banks after 30 days can escalate grievance to the Integrated RBI Ombudsman under the Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS).
